messages.author: 32ee0060f636e4f2
messages.subject: change my server from localhost
parts:
Hi All;
I am using RStudio How can I change my personal ubuntu cloud server, when I run an app on the server it calls http://localhost:8100/ ,
i want to change it to call http://"myserver":8100/.

How can I do that, I will appreciate your support

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: change my server from localhost
parts: Right now we don't have a way to do this directly, but what you can do is call runApp with the launch.browser argument set to FALSE, and then launch the correct URL using browseURL. You can write your own wrapper function that does this and use it instead of using runApp directly.

messages.subject: Re: change my server from localhost
parts:
Hi Joe;
Thanks.
This worked perfectly for me

appRun <- function ( path){
  browseURL(url="http://myServer:8100",)
  runApp(path,launch.browser=FALSE)   
}
appRun( "~/testapp")
